Shri Ashish Kumar Kurmi - Advocate for the applicant.
 Shri Rajeev Kumar Pandey Panel Lawyer for the responden
 Order
This is first bail application filed on behalf of applicant under Section 483 of the Bharatiya Nagarik Suraksha Sanhita, 2023.

2. The applicant is in jail since 27.09.2024 in connection with Crime No.52 of 2024 registered at P.S. Chhanbila District-Sagar for the offence punishable under Sections 366A, 376(2)(n), 376(2)(f)
and 506 of the IPC and under Sections 3/4, 5n/6 and 5(L)/6 of POCSO Act, 2012.
3 .
Prosecution story in brief is that applicant repeatedly committed aggravated penetrated sexual assault on minor prosecutrix, aged approximately about 17 years.
4. Learned counsel for the applicant submits that applicant is in jail since 27.09.2024.
After investigation, charge-sheet has been filed.
It is also urged that prosecutrix and her parents have been examined and they did not support the prosecution story.
Further, from prosecutrix's statement recorded under Section 183 of BNSS, it is evident that it is a case of consensual relationship and prosecutrix had left her house at her own.
No injuries have been found on the NEUTRAL CITATION NO. 2025:MPHC-JBP:21970 2 MCRC-20067-2025 person of prosecutrix.
On above grounds, it is urged that applicant be released on bail.
5. Learned Panel Lawyer for the respondent/State, on the other hand, has opposed the application.

sentences.text: 6. Looking to overall facts and circumstances of the case, I deem it proper to release the applicant on bail.

7 . It is directed that applicant be released on bail on his furnishing a personal bond in the sum of Rs.25,000/- (Rupees Twenty Five Thousand only) with one solvent surety in the like amount to the satisfaction of the trial Court, for his regular appearance before the trial Court during trial with a condition that he shall remain present before the concerned Court on all the dates fixed by it during trial.
He shall abide by all the conditions enumerated under Section 480(3) of Bharatiya Nagarik Suraksha Sanhita, 2023.
8. This order shall be effective till the end of the trial.
However, in case of bail jump and breach of any of the conditions of bail, it shall become ineffective.
9. Soft copy of this bail order be sent immediately/forthwith to the applicant through concerned Jail Superintendent.
10. M.Cr.C. stands allowed and disposed of.
11. Certified copy as per rules.
